svg.title: Picking two open device requests at random, the chance the pair are:
svg.desc: Lines by month, each a share squared: both v6. Source: Cloudflare Radar.
svg.text: Picking two open device requests at random, the chance the pair are:

circle.title: In May 2023, pick two requests on open devices at random: there was a 7.0% chance both came from v6 addresses, because 26.5% of requests on open devices came from a v6 address that month and 26.5% squared is 7.0%. Two peers need both ends on v6 to connect that way, so this is the chance a random pair of peers in a swarm could.
